m.s: Finely shred the cabbage and toss with the juice of {lime*0.5}, some chopped {coriander} and a pinch of salt.
Stir together {mayo}, {sriracha}, {sourcream} and a squeeze of the remaining lime. Cut the rest of the lime into wedges.
Pat {whitefish} dry and cut into fingers. Mix {flour} with {smokedpaprika}, {cumin} and 1 tsp salt, then toss the fish in it until coated.
Heat 1cm of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the fish in batches for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and it flakes easily. Drain on paper towel.
Warm {tortillas} in a dry frying pan for 20 seconds a side. Slice {avocado}.
Fill each taco with slaw, fish, avocado and a drizzle of sauce. Serve with the lime wedges and the rest of the coriander.

l: Turn it into a bowl: fish over rice and slaw, sauce on the side. Best eaten within a day. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
g: GF flour for the GF fish (fried first in fresh oil), and corn tortillas.
